user.title: Set up Heizlast HA
user.description: Set up the fixed ground-floor and upper-floor heat-load dashboard. After setup, open Heizlast HA in the sidebar to inspect the documented planning data and assign existing Home Assistant temperature sensors. The dashboard is provided automatically.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Heizlast HA integration is supported.

confirm.title: Reload the updated dashboard
confirm.description:
The Heizlast HA dashboard has changed in version {version}. Open dashboards may still use the previous card.

Reload every open Home Assistant dashboard in your browser (F5 or the reload button). In the companion app, close and reopen the dashboard; if it still shows the old card, reset the frontend cache in the app settings. Saved sensor assignments are preserved.

After reloading, return to this repair and confirm to dismiss the notice.

abort.dashboard_changed: The dashboard has changed again. Open the current dashboard repair, reload it, and confirm there.
abort.dashboard_unavailable: Heizlast HA is currently unavailable. Enable the integration before confirming the dashboard reload.
